name: microdata-tools-se
description: Tooling for working with Swedish administrative register microdata — register metadata search through the hosted catalog MCP server, project_data.json order drafting, local mock data, and a research-project scaffold whose outputs leave MONA through the toolkit export gate.

catalog_url.title: Catalog MCP URL
catalog_url.description: The catalog MCP server the agent answers from: the global catalog (https://reg-meta.vqv.uk/mcp), or your steward's catalog when your data comes from its holdings (SWECOV: https://data.swecov.se/mcp). Restart Claude Code after changing it.
